**The register is a declaration, not a behaviour claim.** The command surface is built from `surface/dispatch-table.json`, so the register at a revision states what that revision exposes. It does not state that any of it works. Where this page and your binary disagree, **your binary is right**.

**No exit codes are listed per command.** The register's per-command exit tables are measurements of _v2_, and v3 does not reproduce them everywhere, so they are not published here as v3's contract. Every command follows the one surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes).

## The commands

| Command                   | What it does                                  | In v3.0.1 | Reads or writes | Undo       |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------- | ---------- |
| `intent claude`           | Claude Code integration                       | yes       | read            | --         |
| `intent claude subagents` | Manage Claude Code subagents                  | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent claude skills`    | Manage Claude Code skills                     | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent claude rules`     | List and show rule-library rules              | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent claude hook`      | Run a named Intent hook                       | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent claude upgrade`   | Apply Claude canon to the project             | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |
| `intent claude ws`        | Manage whiteboard workstreams                 | yes       | mutate          | idempotent |
| `intent claude start`     | Launch a Claude session bound to a workstream | yes       | mutate          | one-way    |

## Retired

These do not exist in v3. They refuse with an exit code that distinguishes _removed_ from _never built_, so a v2-era script gets an answer rather than an unknown-command error.

| Command               | What it did in v2                               |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `intent claude prime` | Generate MEMORY.md content for a Claude session |

## `intent claude`

Claude Code integration

```
intent claude <subcommand>
```

|                 |                                                            |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| In `v3.0.1`     | yes                                                        |
| Reads or writes | read                                                       |
| Undo            | not applicable -- the register records this verb as a read |
| Over MCP        | no                                                         |

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Type         | Required | Values                                                           | Notes |
| ------------ | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `subcommand` | `subcommand` | yes      | `subagents`, `skills`, `rules`, `hook`, `upgrade`, `ws`, `start` |       |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent claude --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## `intent claude subagents`

Manage Claude Code subagents

```
intent claude subagents <verb> [<name>...] [flags]
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.0.1`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | idempotent |
| Over MCP        | no         |

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type         | Required | Values                                         | Notes |
| -------- | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `verb`   | `subcommand` | yes      | `list`, `install`, `sync`, `uninstall`, `show` |       |
| `name`   | `string`     | no       |                                                |       |

**Flags**

| Flag            | Takes | Default | What it does                                                           |
| --------------- | ----- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-v`            | no    |         | Show full descriptions in `list`                                       |
| `--force`, `-f` | no    |         | Overwrite an agent manifest that already exists                        |
| `--all`         | no    |         | Every unit this install carries (install) or has installed (uninstall) |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent claude subagents --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## `intent claude skills`

Manage Claude Code skills

```
intent claude skills <verb> [<name>...] [flags]
```

|                 |            |
| --------------- | ---------- |
| In `v3.0.1`     | yes        |
| Reads or writes | mutate     |
| Undo            | idempotent |
| Over MCP        | no         |

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type         | Required | Values                                         | Notes |
| -------- | ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `verb`   | `subcommand` | yes      | `list`, `install`, `sync`, `uninstall`, `show` |       |
| `name`   | `string`     | no       |                                                |       |

**Flags**

| Flag            | Takes | Default | What it does                                                                           |
| --------------- | ----- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-v`            | no    |         | Show full descriptions in `list`                                                       |
| `--force`, `-f` | no    |         | Overwrite a skill that was changed here, and report the checksum of what was discarded |

| `--all`         | no    |         | Every unit this install carries (install) or has installed (uninstall)                 |

## `intent claude upgrade`

Apply Claude canon to the project

```
intent claude upgrade [flags]
```

|                 |         |
| --------------- | ------- |
| In `v3.0.1`     | yes     |
| Reads or writes | mutate  |
| Undo            | one-way |
| Over MCP        | no      |

**Flags**

| Flag              | Takes | Default | What it does                                                                             |
| ----------------- | ----- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--apply`         | no    |         | Write the canon; without it the command reports only                                     |
| `--force`         | no    |         | Overwrite user-edited canon files (CLAUDE.md without the marker, and .intent_critic.yml) |
| `--skip-settings` | no    |         | Leave .claude/settings.json alone, so no Claude Code session hooks are wired             |

**Exit codes** follow the surface-wide contract on the [index](index.md#exit-codes) (INV-04). `intent claude upgrade --help`, and your own binary, are the authority on this verb.

## Refusals

**There is no per-command refusal list, because the register does not carry one.** A row declares its path, arguments, flags, target, disposition, recoverability, MCP exposure and read-or-mutate, and nothing structural about what it refuses.

The estate-wide roster of refusal variants is in [what Intent ships at this revision](cut-surface.md), taken from a roster that declares itself exhaustive and is checked as one. **It is not attributed to commands anywhere**, and attributing it by reading the variant names would be a guess dressed as a reference.
